'''Kneesaa''' was a humble seamstress in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who was made Queen of the Forests by a powerful nature spirit. "Kneesaa" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kneesaa was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
